name: nwg-dock-hyprland
summary: GTK3 dock for Hyprland, styled with CSS.
description: A dock for Hyprland only, written in Go as part of the nwg-shell project. It shows pinned apps, open windows and a launcher button (nwg-drawer by default), talks to Hyprland over its IPC socket, and is styled with CSS and command-line options. Its right-click menu can toggle floating and fullscreen.
